entry.title: googleapis/google-cloud-dotnet - Releases - 2026-03-30
entry.content:
Google.Cloud.Ces.V1 version 1.0.0-beta02

New features

  • Update public libraries for CES v1

Documentation improvements

  • A comment for field fallback_action in message .google.cloud.ces.v1.LanguageSettings is changed
  • A comment for field project in message .google.cloud.ces.v1.BigQueryExportSettings is changed
  • A comment for field dataset in message .google.cloud.ces.v1.BigQueryExportSettings is changed
  • A comment for field cert in message .google.cloud.ces.v1.TlsConfig is changed
  • A comment for field name in message .google.cloud.ces.v1.Deployment is changed
  • A comment for field app_version in message .google.cloud.ces.v1.Deployment is changed
  • A comment for method RunSession in service SessionService is changed
  • A comment for field entry_agent in message .google.cloud.ces.v1.SessionConfig is changed
  • A comment for field will_continue in message .google.cloud.ces.v1.SessionInput is changed
  • A comment for field interruption_signal in message .google.cloud.ces.v1.BidiSessionServerMessage is changed
  • A comment for field name in message .google.cloud.ces.v1.Tool is changed
  • A comment for field response in message .google.cloud.ces.v1.ExecuteToolResponse is changed
  • A comment for field input_schema in message .google.cloud.ces.v1.RetrieveToolSchemaResponse is changed
  • A comment for field output_schema in message .google.cloud.ces.v1.RetrieveToolSchemaResponse is changed
  • A comment for field tools in message .google.cloud.ces.v1.RetrieveToolsResponse is changed

Google.Ads.DataManager.V1 version 1.0.0-beta06

New features

  • Add INVALID_MERCHANT_ID to the ErrorReason enum for when the merchant_id field is not valid
  • Add EU_POLITICAL_ADVERTISING_DECLARATION_REQUIRED to the ErrorReason enum for campaigns missing the EU political advertising declaration

Google.Cloud.Dataform.V1 version 1.0.0-beta03

New features

  • Add folders and teamFolders related changes to v1

Documentation improvements

  • A comment for field force in message .google.cloud.dataform.v1.DeleteRepositoryRequest is changed

Google.Cloud.NetApp.V1 version 1.15.0

New features

  • Add ONTAP passthrough APIs

Bug fixes

  • An existing value UNIFIED_LARGE_CAPACITY is removed from enum StoragePoolType

Documentation improvements

  • A comment for field source_volume in message .google.cloud.netapp.v1.Backup is changed
  • A comment for field type in message .google.cloud.netapp.v1.StoragePool is changed
  • A comment for field source_backup in message .google.cloud.netapp.v1.RestoreParameters is changed

Google.Cloud.Firestore.Admin.V1 version 3.18.0

New features

  • Add expiration_offset to Field

Documentation improvements

  • Update documentation for Field

Google.Cloud.Dialogflow.V2Beta1 version 1.0.0-beta29

New features

  • Updated v2beta1 dialogflow client libraries

Google.Cloud.Dialogflow.V2 version 4.29.0

New features

  • Updated v2 dialogflow client libraries

Google.Cloud.Dialogflow.Cx.V3 version 3.1.0

New features

  • Updated v3 dialogflow client libraries with dtmf_pattern and trace_blocks

Google.Cloud.Bigtable.Admin.V2 version 3.32.0

New features

  • Add locations field to AutomatedBackupPolicy

Documentation improvements

  • A comment for field retention_period in message .google.bigtable.admin.v2.Table is changed
  • A comment for field frequency in message .google.bigtable.admin.v2.Table is changed

Google.Cloud.BackupDR.V1 version 2.9.0

New features

  • Adding new workload specific fields for AlloyDB
